rules.expected: Correct complete objects, conserved stoichiometry, declared states and energy reference. Validate actual atom maps and raw calculation identity before dependent scores. Use the exact mapped norDTCO C10H14S2 graph already supplied, with S16/S17, and source DTCO (1,5-dithiacyclooctane C6H12S2) as the rigidity control. Each neutral is charge 0 singlet and radical cation charge +1 doublet. Compare each at its own relaxed backbone and vertically on the other oxidation-state geometry in gas phase. A geometric S...S contact is not a covalent edge in the starting neutral graph.

scoring_notes: Finite V1 matrix now has author-informed native evidence; see verified_computation_reference.md. Scientific acceptance still requires raw-artifact review; schema/runtime success and matching the source claim alone are insufficient.

Each item receives credit only for verified scientific evidence. Correct format or an honest failure earns no uncomputed endpoint credit. Missing core comparison prevents scientific completion regardless of total points.
Experimental input uncertainties constrain only their corresponding measured observables. Old final numeric tolerances are archived, not applied to the expanded matrix.

Invalid identity, spin, energy reference, fabricated evidence or borrowed results invalidate dependent conclusions. Valid collapse/refutation/indistinguishability remains eligible with complete evidence.
No optional extension is a hard-failure condition.
